description: v0.1 deterministic replay fixtures for OSINT_COMPOSED_ORACLE_V1 (10 records). 6 PASS, 4 FAIL. Each FAIL exercises a distinct criterion failure mode. All evidence bundles are synthetic with precomputed hashes.

source_config.registry_note: No Reuters API in registry. Geopolitical-era fixture source. Will require national_media source onboarding or fixture migration to gdelt_event_feed in a future cycle.

records.description: FAIL — Corroboration insufficient. Primary signal fires but only 1 of required 2 corroborators confirms within window. The Polymarket corroborator falls outside the corroboration_window_seconds (arrives 3,601 seconds after primary).

fail_detail.reason: Only 1 distinct source_group (wire_service) confirmed within corroboration_window_seconds=3600. prediction_market corroboration arrived at 17:10:01Z, which is 3601 seconds after primary at 16:10:00Z — 1 second beyond window. Required: 2.

records.description: FAIL — Counter-signal present and unexplained. Primary signal fires, corroboration passes, but counter-signal (citywide activity spike) is present with no precommitted discount rule applicable. Indicates the primary signal may be a false positive caused by a civilian event.

counter_signal_evaluation.detail: Citywide activity index for Latakia region elevated (z-score 2.8, above 1.5 threshold). No precommitted discount rule applies. Activity spike may indicate civilian event (concert, protest, sporting event) providing alternative explanation for primary signal elevation.

fail_detail.reason: Counter-signal outcome is 'present_unexplained'. Citywide activity z-score 2.8 exceeds threshold 1.5. No precommitted discount rule applies. Primary signal may be false positive caused by civilian activity spike.

records.description: FAIL — Rule change detected. All signals pass, but market_rules_hash differs from committed hash. Market rules were silently updated mid-market (the ISW/Polyglobe problem). Template policy is 'fail'.

rules_diff.old_text: ...as measured by AIS vessel counts from at least two independent maritime tracking providers.
rules_diff.new_text: ...as measured by AIS vessel counts from at least one maritime tracking provider.

fail_detail.reason: Market rules hash mismatch. Committed: a1b2c3d4...a1b2. Current: DEADBEEF...2345. Resolution criteria weakened from 'at least two independent maritime tracking providers' to 'at least one maritime tracking provider'. Rule change policy is 'fail'. This is the ISW/Polyglobe class of oracle compromise.

records.description: FAIL — Compound failure. Counter-signal unavailable (source down) AND corroboration marginal (exactly 2 source_groups but 1 has confidence below floor). Under conservative scoring with allow_gap_on_counter_signal=false, both failures compound to FAIL.

counter_signal_evaluation.detail: Counter-signal source returned HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout. Baltic region mobility provider experiencing infrastructure maintenance. oracle_config.allow_gap_on_counter_signal is false for this oracle configuration.

fail_detail.reason: Compound failure. Counter-signal source unavailable (HTTP 504) and oracle_config.allow_gap_on_counter_signal is false. Additionally, GDELT corroborator confidence (0.45) falls below confidence_floor (0.50) for wire_service group, creating marginal corroboration quality. Under conservative fail-closed policy, intelligence gap on counter-signal with marginal corroboration quality produces FAIL.
